programme.desc: When eleven-year-old Herman Lehmann is torn away from his frontier home by an Apache raiding party, he must adapt in order to survive. He soon forgets the life he unwillingly left behind and is adopted by an Apache family. For close to a decade, he lives as a Native American, learning their language and customs. Eventually, he even joins the same type of raiding party that separated him from his family. Though the years pass by, Herman's mother never gives up hope that she will be reunited with her son. One day, she hears a rumor of a blue-eyed Apache now living on a reservation. Could this be her long-lost son? programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Joe Pantoliano stars as a shock-jock whose specialty is ridiculing UFO believers. But when a true Believer sets himself on fire in front of Stan, the D.J. finds the very foundation of his disbelief beginning to crumble. Cynthia Nixon also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a cancer-ridden doctor (Robert Hayes) is given a full-body transplant, he soon develops disturbing visions of a life he never led, of loves he's never experienced... and of a shocking, brutal murder. Wendel Meldrum and Thomas Cavanaugh also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A brilliant inventor (Ralph Waite) who murdered a man who stole credit for his work, is double crossed by the other inmates in jail when they discover his "small friends" -- microscopic machines --can seve just about any purposeï¿½including jailbreak.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Grell had come to earth not as equals, but as slaves. Now, an uprising has gripped the world in fear, and a high-ranking government official (Ted Shackelford), who is lost in Grell territory, experiences firsthand the ugly face of racism.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Dr. Eberhardt (Ralph Macchio) discovers a way for comatose patients to communicate with each other by interfacing with a computer. But when he hooks himself up to the machine, he discovers a cyberspace "paradise" he may never be able to leave!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson -- who starred in the very first episode of the classic series -- returns to the Outer Limits as an aging astronaut whose 1963 mission was a career-ending disaster. If he can just get back to space, perhaps he can clear his name.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.desc: Cintron and Erica's relationship reaches its breaking point. Eric and Erica go undercover at the Mansion to find Layla while Robin has the same idea unbeknownst to anyone. Everything comes full circle as the siblings are willing to make the ultimate sacrifice for each other.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is My Teen Blinded By Love?
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look into the nanny affair that shattered a marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This two-syllable expression is arguably the most divisive word in society. Dr. Phil tackles this touchy topic with help from a panel of outspoken luminaries: civil rights activist Rev. Al Sharpton; legendary comedian and writer Paul Mooney; CSI :New York actor and author Hill Harper; comedian Sheryl Underwood and conservative radio talk show host Michael Graham.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Statistics show that 2,000 teens get pregnant every day. Moms and dads: Watch this show with your teenagers, because it can impact their lives and yours! Two families face off over who should raise baby Miley. Paige, 17, and her boyfriend, Jordan, 18, are determined to raise their child on their own, even though they live with Jordan’s dad, Chris. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On July 6, 2012, 16-year-old Skylar Neese was stabbed to death by her two best friends, Shelia Eddy and Rachel Shoaf. Six months later, Rachel confessed to police and led them to Skylar’s remains. Shelia continued to plead not guilty -- until January 2014, when she finally admitted her part in the brutal murder. Both teens claimed they killed Skylar because they “didn’t want to be friends with her anymore” -- but was that their real motive? And, who was the mastermind behind the plot? Dr. Phil sits down with Sklylar’s parents, Dave and Mary, who say they’re struggling to comprehend what happened to their little girl. How can they heal after such a horrific tragedy? And, how could Shelia -- who had been friends with Skylar since she was 8 -- and Rachel commit such a heinous crime? Hear from Shelia’s cousin, who says Shelia isn’t the monster people say she is. And, friends of Rachel’s family weigh in. Were there any red flags they say they missed? Then, a close friend of Shelia and Skylar claims she knows the real reason behind the murder. Does Skylar’s journal entry confirm her suspicions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A headline making story of a husband’s affair with a co-worker that led to murder. Now the wife and the mistress come face to face for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Daniel Pelosi was convicted of second-degree murder in the slaying of investment banker and multimillionaire Ted Ammon -- the husband of his lover, Generosa. He is currently serving 25 years to life but now claims he is ready to explain what really happened the night of the murder. Dr. Phil visits Pelosi behind bars.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alan and Amanda say for the past nine years, Alan’s pictures from social media have been used as catfish bait to lure women into online relationships. Several of the victims of this catfish reached out to Amanda and Alan warning them, but Amanda says it got scary when she learned one of the victims received interior and exterior pictures of Amanda and Alan’s home. With the help of a private investigator, Alan and Amanda discovered the catfish wasn’t a man after all but a 24-year-old woman with a boyfriend, who says he had no idea she was living this secret online life. Dr. Phil discovers this isn’t the first time this catfish has been caught.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: I'm a Slave to My Spouse
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests and the loved ones who feel trapped by them. Jeffrey hates that his wife of seven months, Mindy, goes out clubbing with her younger friends, who he says are a bad influence on her. Mindy leaves the kids with Jeffrey's 16-year-old daughter and parties until 6:00 a.m., while he works the night shift. Mindy calls Jeffrey “a warden,” and says if he had his way, she’d never leave the house. Then, Jason claims his wife, Terrie, is lazy. He says he has to clean the house, do chores, take care of the kids and balance two checkbooks! Terrie says her large chest and arthritis prevent her from doing household tasks. Can Jason get his wife to clean up her act?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Wake-Up Call for the Nation Pt 1
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished finally faces her family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Audrey made headlines and landed behind bars for running a surrogacy scam, by pretending to be pregnant and conning couples out of thousands of dollars. Now, she comes face to face with one of the couples she scammed on Dr. Phil’s stage. Hear how they say they reacted when they learned there was no baby. How does Audrey respond? Tune in to this emotional Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Exclusive: The Co-Eds And The Catfish
programme.desc: In one of the most twisted and bizarre love deceptions ever covered on Dr. Phil, seven female college students from Brigham Young University face the man they say they fell in love with online but never met in person. In a surprising twist, their one-time Prince Charming reveals that he, too, was victimized by a catfish who stole his identity. Tune in as the real person who lured these young women into fake relationships comes forward. Who would orchestrate such a tangled web of deception and why? Can these co-eds find forgiveness and gain closure?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Teen Can’t Stand My Husband
programme.desc: Marriages with blended families have a higher rate of divorce than the first trip down the aisle, and today’s guests say they know exactly why. When Kip married Vicky, he says he knew that her daughter, Tory, was part of the package. Now, he struggles to get along with the 17-year- old, and they often engage in jaw-dropping screaming matches followed by a month without speaking. Hear the scathing remarks that Dr. Phil describes as the most inappropriate comments that he’s ever heard a stepparent say about a child. What led someone to fear for Tory’s safety and make a worried call to authorities? What, if any, ownership do this teen and her mother have in this family dynamic? And, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters, one of whom has run away. Can this family finally have a happy ending?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have your children gone from little angels to kids gone wild? Are they whiney, tantrum-throwing, feet-stomping, door-slamming, spoiled and entitled? Well, good news, Mom and Dad! Dr. Phil is launching his parenting boot camp and teaching parents how to take back control and live in peace for the very first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Couples confront post-honeymoon marriage challenges.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How do you determine whether someone is fit to be a parent? Should a parent previously ruled unfit by the court system ever be allowed to regain custody? What should you do if your parenting skills are called into question by a family member? Dr. Phil's guests are feuding mother and daughter, Barbara and Nicole, who have been battling for two years over the custody of Nicole's son, Ethan.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Madisen says she wants desperately for a place to belong and has made terrible choices in an attempt to do just that. She claims to have already joined a gang, gotten pregnant and hit a teacher. Everyone, even Madisen, agrees she is troubled, but why does Dr. Phil say it would’ve been a bigger surprise if she didn't turn out this way? Did her father really try to forfeit his parental rights? And did her mother turn a blind eye to so many red flags? Learn why Dr. Phil believes it’s not too late for this teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents: How do you sound an alarm when your out-of-control teenager thinks he or she is invincible? When 16-year-old Chris and 19-year-old Brett last appeared on the show, they said they were just acting like normal teens drinking, smoking marijuana and vandalizing property. They say jail is a joke, but with the help of Dr. Phil, they find out that life behind bars is no laughing matter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How far would you go to protect your child?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: I Spanked My Wife with a Wooden Spoon
programme.desc: A man makes headlines for spanking his wife with a wooden spoon.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Living with an alcoholic parent is one of the most difficult and heart-wrenching experiences a child can go through. Heather, 28, and Alexandra, 21, say their mother, Joey, is a pathetic drunk, and if she doesn't get clean once and for all, they will walk away from her forever.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of Shanda Sharer who was murdered confronts one of the convicted killers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman endures nearly two decades of severe abuse, allegedly inflicted by her adoptive parents.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Teen Girl Obsessed With Her Ex
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? programme.title: Downfall and Liberation

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: The War continues
programme.desc: Having previously been dominated by the Empires of Russia, Germany and Austro-Hungary, many peoples of Eastern Europe had cherished hopes of gaining freedom after World War I.

programme.title: The End of the Ottomanns
programme.desc: At the end of WWI, the Treaty of Versailles and the Treaty of Sèvres stood for a new world order. This is where the victorious powers decided the Ottoman Empire was to be broken up.

programme.title: Gold for Kim - A Life for North Korea's Leader
programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: Osama Bin Laden - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Just after midnight on May 2, 2011, United States Special Forces raided the compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where Osama Bin laden had been hiding for years. “America’s public enemy number one” was killed during the operation. The Navy SEALs thoroughly searched his house, recovering everything that could provide information about Bin Laden and his terrorist network Al-Qaeda: His documents and private correspondence, as well as every electronic data carrier.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: Forest of Heroes
programme.desc: From Lower Saxony and North Rhine Westphalia, from Osnabrück to Paderborn, one of Germany’s most beautiful forests extends for some 150 kilometers - the Teutoburg Forest. The low mountain range became famous due to the Varus Battle that took place in 9 AD. It was here that Hermann, or Arminius, the Cherusci Prince vanquished the Roman occupation army.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: It’s in spring 2008, when the telephone of the Archaeological State Office Schleswig-Holstein suddenly rings. The message archeologist Martin Segschneider receives makes him curious.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A five-round heavyweight title eliminator between the number one ranked contender Levi Rigters (18-2, 8 KO) and ‘The Golden Wolf’ Bahram Rajabzadeh (69-3, 61 KO). The winner will face ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven (64-10, 21 KO) on December 7 in the main event of COLLISION 7. In the co-main event of the evening, Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-4-1, 13 KO) clashes with Nico ‘Big Sexy’ Horta (23-9, 3 KO) in a monster heavyweight clash with big implication for the rankings. Croatian kickboxing legend Mladen Brestovac (55-14-1, 37 KO) will make his final walk to the ring in his hometown of Zagreb. ‘The Scorpion Sting’ will take on newcomer Karim Dian (16-13, 3 KO) to cap off an illustrious career. Top ten heavyweights Nordine Mahieddine (28-15, 13 KO) and Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) will collide in what is a guaranteed barn burner between two prolific KO artist.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The eight-man one-night GLORY Light Heavyweight Grand Prix will crown the baddest light heavyweight striker on the planet. The eight participants are: GLORY champion, #C Tarik Khbabez (58-10-1, 28 KO), Morocco. Former champion, #1 Donegi Abena (27-10, 7 KO), Suriname. Former champion, #2 Sergej Maslobojev (38-6, 23 KO), Lithuania. Undefeated in GLORY, #3 Stefan Latescu (17-2, 8 KO), Romania. ‘Mister Cool’ #4 Ibrahim El Bouni (41-9-1, 22 KO), Morocco. The wild & unpredictable, #5 Bahram Rajabzadeh (67-2, 59 KO), Azerbaijan. Top French light heavyweight, #6 Pascal Toure (20-6, 7 KO), France. Veteran fighter, #7 Bogdan Stoica (58-14, 40 KO), Romania.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The welterweight superfight between former GLORY world champion Endy Semeleer (36-2, 18 KO) and current GLORY lightweight world champion Tyjani Beztati (26-4, 9 KO) will take center stage in the main event of the evening. After dominating the lightweight division, Beztati moves up to welterweight for the very first time in his GLORY career. GLORY featherweight world champion Petch (169-40-3, 27 KO) and RISE national champion Kento Haraguchi (25-3-1, 14 KO) made their trilogy fight official for the co-main event. Two former middleweight title challengers collide as the number one ranked Michael Boapeah (17-4-1, 7 KO) takes on the number three ranked Ulric Bokeme (32-5, 17 KO), both fighters chasing a rematch at champion Donovan Wisse. Top Dutch star Tayfun Özcan (86-10-3, 28 KO) will make his highly anticipated GLORY debut against French champion Majid Amarouche (25-2-1, 10 KO).

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Ray Scott had no plan other than a hypothetical idea of launching a legitimate pro bass fishing tour. Through his uncanny salesmanship the 1967 All-American was a success leading to the formation of the Bass Anglers Sportsman Society (B.A.S.S.).

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: By the 1980s B.A.S.S. was gaining national media notoriety while membership swelled to nearly 500 000. The Bassmasters TV series debuted in 1984 to capture the drama as it unfolded on the water. The show followed the Bassmaster Tournament Trail.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: B.A.S.S. in the 90s was best described as explosive and exciting. A legend won his fourth Bassmaster Classic while another hero retired. Another became the first B.A.S.S. millionaire.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bill Dance a furniture salesman from Memphis Tenn. caught the first bass in Scott’s 1967 All-American tournament a harbinger of great things to come. Dance went on to become the sport’s first superstar fueled by his outgoing charisma.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Roland Martin early on established himself as a B.A.S.S. superstar by winning 19 tournaments. Jimmy Houston’s recognizable giggle mop of blonde hair and wide-framed sunglasses made him an instant hit.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Hank Parker who won the Classic in 1979 and 1989 also won 1983 B.A.S.S. Angler of the Year. In 14 years as a B.A.S.S. pro Parker qualified for 14 Classics before retiring at the age of 37 going on to be successful with his Hank Parker Outdoor Magazine.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Voted by fans as the greatest professional bass angler of all time Rick Clunn won four Bassmaster Classics two of them in consecutive years and went on to compete in an unprecedented 32 Classics.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the story of a river and how it inspired three innovators and dedicated bass fishermen to invent and build an industry and culture that meant everything to them. Those men are Johnny Morris Forrest Wood and Jerry McKinnis.

programme.desc: Watch the inside story of Rick Clunn’s 50-year B.A.S.S. career leading up to his 500th event.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Watch the inside story of superstar Denny Brauer’s incredible career spanning three decades with a Bassmaster Classic win Bassmaster Angler of the Year title 17 wins and in incredible impact on the sport of bass fishing.

programme.desc: Bryan Kerchal is the only amateur angler to win the Bassmaster Classic. See the heartwarming story of his career on The Cast presented by Bass Pro Shops.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: A Few Dollars for Django
programme.desc: Regan, a bounty hunter looking to start a new life, is pulled back into action when a murder sends him after bank robbers. In Montana, he steps into a range war between farmers and cattlemen while investigating. With a sheriff's star in hand, Regan must navigate dangerous territory to bring justice while seeking his own peace.

programme.title: Payment in Blood
programme.desc: In 1867 Texas, after the Civil War, Colonel Thomas Blake and his men refuse to surrender, raiding Yankee towns. Rumors swirl that Blake kills for pleasure, not the Confederacy, leading to large bounties for his capture. However, Blake seeks $200,000 that vanished during the war from Confederate coffers. He sends Chamaco Gonzales to track down the missing fortune, hidden in General Beauregard's strong box.

programme.title: The Executioner of God
programme.desc: A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

programme.title: The Restless Breed
programme.desc: After Mitch Baker’s father is killed by gun-runners, he follows them to Mexico for revenge. In the border town of Mission, Texas, Mitch faces off with gang leader Jim Simmons, determined to take justice into his own hands, despite warnings from the sheriff.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Where the Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Young adventurer Gipo owns a fifth of a rock marking a gold mine. With the help of the alluring Lulu Belle, he braves deadly dangers to recover the missing pieces and claim the treasure, facing treachery and peril along the way.

programme.title: If you meet Sartana... Pray for your Death
programme.desc: Crooked bankers plan an insurance swindle and hire a Mexican gang to steal the bank's gold but they also pay Lasky's gang to kill the Mexicans.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Reverend's Colt
programme.desc: Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

programme.title: Wanted
programme.desc: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
programme.desc: Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programme.title: Sabata the Killer
programme.desc: Sabata and Mangosta are bank robbers, who after a bank job, through a series of events, end up teaming up with the bank clerk, Peter. They then go on the run with Peter's boss and a hired posse equipped with the latest technology in weapons on their trail.

programme.title: Three Wives
programme.desc: After their husbands commit a heist and flee, three women travel to Argentina to hunt them down.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: To save his kidnapped wife, a warden frees a criminal, uncovering a massive political conspiracy.

programme.title: Napoli serenata calibro 10
programme.desc: A gritty crime drama set in Naples, where a man is caught between loyalty and betrayal.

programme.desc: Programmed to kill, a rogue cyborg defies his mission and fights for humanity’s survival.

programme.desc: An ex-con and a stuntman have to substitute two threatened rich Brazilians.

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35

But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.title: Streetwise

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: We put the Wiesmann MF5 at the racetrack in Spa-Francochamps in the Belgian Ardennes to the test. Also: Audi A1 vs. Mini Cooper RS. And: the GT Academy 2011 qualifying rounds.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Nurburgring 24 Hours is considered the most difficult long distance race in motor sports. Volkswagen set themselves this challenge with a car built especially for this occasion, their Golf 24.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The Mercedes-Benz SL 65 AMG is the ultimate German muscle car in a tailor-made suit. Also: the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG, the Formula 1 safety car. And: BMW's 6 series models.

programme.title: Jaguar D-Type
programme.desc: The high-achiever at the 24 hours of Le Mans. The Jaguar D-Type won the toughest endurance race in the world three times in a row.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: What a joy it is when elegance meets extraordinary performance! The Maserati Quattroporte, the Kelleners BMW GranCoupe and Porsche's 911 4S embody the perfect melange. We took a closer look at these prime examples of power combined with style.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the famous 24 hours of Le Mans race, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in Le Mans 2013.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Porsche 911 shows stylistic modesty like no other sports car in the world. It doesn't boast, avoids any loud appearance and puts form over function. We explored the history behind this iconic sports car and the reason why it has been so successful for more than 50 years. In addition: Porsche's Turbo S model, the traditional top model of the brand's 911 production series.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 - The first turbocharged Aston Martin

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Despite a production number of nearly 1.4 million units the Chevrolet Corvair is virtually unknown in Europe. It was innovative, efficient, modern and cheap. Nevertheless, it was slandered, torn apart and later reviled.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Winning the iconic Dakar Rally for a record 13 times, Frenchman Stéphane Peterhansel had a rather unusual career as he switched from motorbikes to cars and was enormously successful with both vehicles.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: From the 1950s to 1970s Hans Herrmann came to fame as a successful Formula 1 and sportscar driver for manufacturers like Porsche, Mercedes-Benz and Maserati who also won also the 24 Hours of Le Mans several times.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: In the US, SUVs aren't usually considered just workhorses but rather treated as everyday vehicles. Americans don't want to miss out on space, comfort and loading capacity. We show you the Chevrolet Suburban, Jeep Cherokee and GMC Yukon.

programme.title: 4x4

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: When the Audi A1 becomes the S1 and the Golf gets an R in its name, these small cars turn into all-wheel beasts. Also: the Mini Countryman gets a rejuvenation. And: a test drive with the best-selling Volvo XC60.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 1
programme.desc: Tourist Trophy on the Isle of Man. The abbreviation "TT" could also stand for death and the devil. Every year the most dangerous motorcycle race in the world takes place. One lap in the Tourist Trophy is 61 kilometers long. 260 curves require everything from the riders. It's a unique myth.

programme.title: Isle of Man - Tourist Trophy, Part 2
programme.desc: The most dangerous motorcycle race in the world on the Isle of Man. Marshals at the TT are responsible for the highest possible levels of safety.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The emphatically sporty cars and motorbikes of BMW are equally successful with customers and in racing. However, the former aircraft engine manufacturer's entry into automobile production threatened to fail at an early stage.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Porsche 550 Spyder is small and fast, but only 140 units were built. It was Porsche's first racing sports car and laid the foundation for the German manufacturer to be considered a force in car racing today.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Racing has been a matter of the heart for Ford for over 100 years. Henry Ford already wins the first race with his first car. Thousands of other victories were to follow.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The development of engineering at BMW has always been closely linked to motorsport. Racing has always played a decisive role in shaping the brand and setting the pace for its future.

programme.title: Car History

programme.title: Glas 1700 GT
programme.desc: The Glas GT looks like a Ferrari, but comes from the province of Lower Bavaria in Germany. In the early 1960s it was one of the few German sports cars.

programme.title: Peugeot 205 Turbo 16

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Frank Slopianka is a racing junkie and constantly takes part in such events. US car fans Kati and Patrick join him for the Race 61, a rock and race festival in Finowfurt near Berlin. There Frank and and his Dragster Camaro take part in the 1/8 mile race.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - French Riviera
programme.desc: German entrepeneur Tillmann Miritz loves vintage cars and has a dream: driving through the USA in his Mercedes Cabriolet 280 SE 3.5. He drives along the picturesque French Riviera and visits a classic car collector before his 280 gets shipped.

programme.sub-title: Mercedes 280 SE goes America - New York

Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Jaguar XJR

programme.title: Stunt Heroes

programme.title: Stunt Heroes

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: Bentley S2 Continental Flying Spur

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

Making their way through some thick jungle, they spend a night in a remote family village on their way to a spectacular fire-dancing tribe.

programme.title: Departures
programme.sub-title: Departures S03 E06 - Papua New Guinea - Without A Paddle
programme.desc: Leaving the islands, the guys head into mainland PNG and drive up into the rugged Highlands with their friend Nick. They travel through Goroka, where they take part in an embarrassing Mudmen dance ritual involving bows, arrows and loincloths. They prepare for an epic journey: A private flight north to a remote grass airstrip, where they have three days to make their way down the extremely remote Sepik River and try to become true men of the Sepik.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Hayman's Way
programme.desc: Follow David Hayman as he unearths the people and places that make Scotland unique.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: Our journey begins in Southeast Asia, immersing us in many cultures as we find spirituality in a rock temple in Sri Lanka. We will sail through the Indian Ocean towards Sumatra in Indonesia, there we will find a place of rest in Lake Toba one of the super volcanoes of the world and, finally, we will end our tour in one of the most beautiful landscapes of the Caribbean, the Island of Puerto Rico, a place also rich in history and culture.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 61: La confesion de Victoria y la furia de Don Carlos
programme.desc: La Loba le dice a Josefina que ya no puede seguir chantajeando a Salvador porque ella conoce todos los secretos de su novio y nadie los podrá separar. Don Carlos escucha cuando Socorro le reclama a Victoria por haber sido amante del Tigre, Don Carlos se pone furioso, saca a Cocó de la casa y luego intenta ahorcar a Victoria. Vicky le confiesa a su esposo que fue ella quien le dio información a Salvador sobre la pelea con Basualdo porque ella por Salvador es capaz de cualquier cosa, Don Carlos la echa de la casa sin un peso y en pijama.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 61: Miguel, Arelys, y Brujeria Pantoja
programme.desc: En la casa de los Pantoja Anselmi discuten Miguel y Arelys, ya que esta ultima al parecer comienza a salir con otros hombres pero Miguel continua enamorado de ella. Mientras Gabriela, le cuenta a su abuela la angustia que siente por lo que puede pensar su madre acerca de el incidente ocurrido entre ella y Ricardo, su abuela le insiste que no siga con esa relación por diferencias sociales, mientras que planeaba hacer brujerías para esa familia. Esa misma noche Moncho camina a su casa con una mesonera, iba ebrio comentando sobre los planes para el día siguiente, mientras que Bertica le esperaba que llegara a su casa.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 104: Theo golpea a Aristigueta, todo explota
programme.desc: Theo no sabe que hacer, esta aturdido, cree que la Nena se burlo de el, y lo piensa aún mas después que Gerson le dice que ese es el mismo que le dio la gran propina el otro día en la entrada del edificio, el mismo del mercado y las flores, ahora Theo entiende todo, no era un levante de Tatiana el que les llevaba todos esos regalos, ella se estaba burlando de el y Aristigueta también, se le acerca a la Nena lleno de rabia y le reclama, en ese momento llega Tatiana feliz por que ve a su mamá en la fiesta de su papá, se extraña al ver a Theo en ese sitio, el le responde que el lo único que hace allí es el ridículo, Aristigueta se les acerca y le exige a Theo que respete y que no se meta que el problema no es con el, pero Aristigueta aprovecha para lucirse una vez mas y le da dinero para que se retire, esto termino con la poca paciencia de Theo y sin pensarlo dos veces le propina un tremendo golpe en la cara a Aristigueta, quien cae al piso, todos los del grupo de música agarran a Theo, Tatiana, le grita a Theo, Gerson quiere mas pelea, llaman a seguridad y Rómulo le pide a Theo que se retire sin dar mas problemas, la Nena esta muy apenada y brava a la vez pues sabe que todo fue planeado por la mente sucia de su ex esposo, quiere explicarle a Theo pero ya es demasiado tarde. En su casa Gladis presiente que algo malo le puede estar pasando a su hijo, Yuraima le dice que se quede tranquila que Gerson esta con Doroteo, entonces Gladis se pone peor, pues la última vez que estuvo con Theo, se robo un carro y estuvo preso. En el carro de Luis Fernando están Ernesto y Alegría, deciden dar unas vueltas a la cuadra, Ernesto le asegura a la muchacha que no pasara nada, pues el sabe manejar desde los doce años, ella accede, luego es ella la que toma el volante, y le dice a Ernesto que ella también sabe manejar, solo rueda el carro un poco y choca contra un camión grande que se encuentra en la cuadra, ahora si que están metidos en un problema, se dan la palabra de no decir nada, deciden poner el carro donde estaba al principio, pero cuando se acercan al lugar se dan cuenta que ya están allí Rómulo, Jose Tadeo, Gonzalo y Ramón, entonces deciden dejarlo en otra calle. Luego si hacen lo que debieron hacer desde el principio y no es otra cosa que entregar las llaves del carro tal y como se lo pidió Felicita. Mientras tanto el propietario del carro, o sea Luis Fernando, aún no encuentra sus llaves, esta seguro que Gerson se las agarro, pues el muchacho lo había amenazado anteriormente y no puede dejar de pensar en eso, María Gracia ya obstinada de Dileidi y ahora de su hermano decide aplicar su plan B para que Luis Fernando se olvide de ese asunto y lo logra. Dileidi quiere hablar con Aureliano, va para la bodega de Gabito y justo cuando están buscando el tema de conversación, empieza una pelea entre Remedios y Gabito, el tema del problema es que Remedios quiere que Gabito esconda la mercancía para que la venda mas tarde a un precio mayor, cosa que Gabito no esta dispuesto hacer, Dileidi se entera que ese es el pan de cada día en esa casa, luego se va para su casa y le cuenta a su mamá lo que se acaba de enterar, a Gladis no le sorprende mucho pues ella sabe que las mujeres en lo que tienen una relación con un hombre lo primero que hacen es tratar de cambiarlo. Entre tanto Theo y Gerson están en la barra de un restaurante en compañía de Marco Aurelio quien le dice que la cosa mas buena que Theo ha hecho en su vida es haberle dado un golpe a Aristigueta que no se preocupe por eso, que se lo merece, por estafador y mala gente, luego se entera que es el mismo que se robo un dinero de un banco y se fue para España, causalidad que Theo tenía sus pocos ahorros guardados en ese banco. La Nena por su parte le reprocha a Aristigueta su mala fe, sabe que lo tenía todo bien planeado para humillar al pobre Theo, el en ves de darle pena le dice a la Nena que lo que mas le sorprende es que ella con ese abolengo que tiene se haya casado con una persona de tan bajo nivel social. Al fin llega Gerson a su casa, Gladis ahora esta mas tranquila. En la casa de Egleé todos se enteran de lo que le paso a la Nena, Rosa que es su amiga se conduele de ella, todo le pasa en el peor de los momentos igual que cuando se caso con Theo, que todo se descubrió en la iglesia, luego se despiden todos y Rómulo se acuesta en el mueble como si el aún viviera allí, Egleé le recuerda que se tiene que ir. Al día siguiente Gladis regaña a Gerson pues se quedo dormido, en la casa de Egleé Cristina le da las llaves del carro a su hermano, pero cuando este sale a la calle en busca de su carro se lleva la sorpresa del día, su carro no esta, justo lo que el sospechaba, el vigilante malandro del edifico de enfrente o sea Gerson le robo el carro, se va para el edificio y lo dice a toda voz, el vigilante de ese edificio le robo su carro por que el lo dice y es así.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 49: Emperatriz cae, pleitos en la clinica
programme.desc: Todos en la casa corren a auxiliar a Emperatriz y Armando se desespera cuando la ve en el suelo inconsciente y golpea con violencia a Marisela a quien culpa de la caída de su hermana, mientras Michelle se alegra y en la Iglesia la vela de la Virgen se apaga. Cuando Berta ve la desesperación de Armando le hace ver que Emperatriz está viva aún y la llevan a la clínica. Y en la misma clínica está ingresada Jennifer con una infección y Daniela llega a visitarla y se encuentra con Inés y comienza a insultarla y Luis Guillermo y Robert tienen que intervenir para evitar que la golpee. Gabriela discute con Juan Carlos y se niega a oír sus súplicas y lo corre de la casa pero Juan Carlos promete volver de nuevo.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Grecia aparece muerta en un parque vestida de novia con un ramo en la mano, y acostada sobre muchas flores. África, Alejandro y Tirso, están muy mal, por lo sucedido. El fiscal mayor habla con Vespasiano y le dio como plazo un mes, para atrapar a la viuda negra, si no cumplen, van a trasladar el caso, a otra jurisdicción. - Ruth va a la casa de Federico, junto con su abogada Roberta, para que le devuelvan a su hijo José Guillermo, ya que Federico y Vicenta no están cumpliendo con lo pactado. Abril e Inmaculada van a ver a Ruth, para proponerle ser la hermana que ellas perdieron según las averiguaciones de Julio, que consiguió los certificados de defunción de la madre y la hermana menor de ellas

La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Grecia aparece muerta en un parque vestida de novia con un ramo en la mano, y acostada sobre muchas flores. África, Alejandro y Tirso, están muy mal, por lo sucedido. El fiscal mayor habla con Vespasiano y le dio como plazo un mes, para atrapar a la viuda negra, si no cumplen, van a trasladar el caso, a otra jurisdicción. - Ruth va a la casa de Federico, junto con su abogada Roberta, para que le devuelvan a su hijo José Guillermo, ya que Federico y Vicenta no están cumpliendo con lo pactado. Abril e Inmaculada van a ver a Ruth, para proponerle ser la hermana que ellas perdieron según las averiguaciones de Julio, que consiguió los certificados de defunción de la madre y la hermana menor de ellas

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 61: La confesion de Victoria y la furia de Don Carlos
programme.desc: La Loba le dice a Josefina que ya no puede seguir chantajeando a Salvador porque ella conoce todos los secretos de su novio y nadie los podrá separar. Don Carlos escucha cuando Socorro le reclama a Victoria por haber sido amante del Tigre, Don Carlos se pone furioso, saca a Cocó de la casa y luego intenta ahorcar a Victoria. Vicky le confiesa a su esposo que fue ella quien le dio información a Salvador sobre la pelea con Basualdo porque ella por Salvador es capaz de cualquier cosa, Don Carlos la echa de la casa sin un peso y en pijama.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 61: Miguel, Arelys, y Brujeria Pantoja
programme.desc: En la casa de los Pantoja Anselmi discuten Miguel y Arelys, ya que esta ultima al parecer comienza a salir con otros hombres pero Miguel continua enamorado de ella. Mientras Gabriela, le cuenta a su abuela la angustia que siente por lo que puede pensar su madre acerca de el incidente ocurrido entre ella y Ricardo, su abuela le insiste que no siga con esa relación por diferencias sociales, mientras que planeaba hacer brujerías para esa familia. Esa misma noche Moncho camina a su casa con una mesonera, iba ebrio comentando sobre los planes para el día siguiente, mientras que Bertica le esperaba que llegara a su casa.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 104: Theo golpea a Aristigueta, todo explota
programme.desc: Theo no sabe que hacer, esta aturdido, cree que la Nena se burlo de el, y lo piensa aún mas después que Gerson le dice que ese es el mismo que le dio la gran propina el otro día en la entrada del edificio, el mismo del mercado y las flores, ahora Theo entiende todo, no era un levante de Tatiana el que les llevaba todos esos regalos, ella se estaba burlando de el y Aristigueta también, se le acerca a la Nena lleno de rabia y le reclama, en ese momento llega Tatiana feliz por que ve a su mamá en la fiesta de su papá, se extraña al ver a Theo en ese sitio, el le responde que el lo único que hace allí es el ridículo, Aristigueta se les acerca y le exige a Theo que respete y que no se meta que el problema no es con el, pero Aristigueta aprovecha para lucirse una vez mas y le da dinero para que se retire, esto termino con la poca paciencia de Theo y sin pensarlo dos veces le propina un tremendo golpe en la cara a Aristigueta, quien cae al piso, todos los del grupo de música agarran a Theo, Tatiana, le grita a Theo, Gerson quiere mas pelea, llaman a seguridad y Rómulo le pide a Theo que se retire sin dar mas problemas, la Nena esta muy apenada y brava a la vez pues sabe que todo fue planeado por la mente sucia de su ex esposo, quiere explicarle a Theo pero ya es demasiado tarde. En su casa Gladis presiente que algo malo le puede estar pasando a su hijo, Yuraima le dice que se quede tranquila que Gerson esta con Doroteo, entonces Gladis se pone peor, pues la última vez que estuvo con Theo, se robo un carro y estuvo preso. En el carro de Luis Fernando están Ernesto y Alegría, deciden dar unas vueltas a la cuadra, Ernesto le asegura a la muchacha que no pasara nada, pues el sabe manejar desde los doce años, ella accede, luego es ella la que toma el volante, y le dice a Ernesto que ella también sabe manejar, solo rueda el carro un poco y choca contra un camión grande que se encuentra en la cuadra, ahora si que están metidos en un problema, se dan la palabra de no decir nada, deciden poner el carro donde estaba al principio, pero cuando se acercan al lugar se dan cuenta que ya están allí Rómulo, Jose Tadeo, Gonzalo y Ramón, entonces deciden dejarlo en otra calle. Luego si hacen lo que debieron hacer desde el principio y no es otra cosa que entregar las llaves del carro tal y como se lo pidió Felicita. Mientras tanto el propietario del carro, o sea Luis Fernando, aún no encuentra sus llaves, esta seguro que Gerson se las agarro, pues el muchacho lo había amenazado anteriormente y no puede dejar de pensar en eso, María Gracia ya obstinada de Dileidi y ahora de su hermano decide aplicar su plan B para que Luis Fernando se olvide de ese asunto y lo logra. Dileidi quiere hablar con Aureliano, va para la bodega de Gabito y justo cuando están buscando el tema de conversación, empieza una pelea entre Remedios y Gabito, el tema del problema es que Remedios quiere que Gabito esconda la mercancía para que la venda mas tarde a un precio mayor, cosa que Gabito no esta dispuesto hacer, Dileidi se entera que ese es el pan de cada día en esa casa, luego se va para su casa y le cuenta a su mamá lo que se acaba de enterar, a Gladis no le sorprende mucho pues ella sabe que las mujeres en lo que tienen una relación con un hombre lo primero que hacen es tratar de cambiarlo. Entre tanto Theo y Gerson están en la barra de un restaurante en compañía de Marco Aurelio quien le dice que la cosa mas buena que Theo ha hecho en su vida es haberle dado un golpe a Aristigueta que no se preocupe por eso, que se lo merece, por estafador y mala gente, luego se entera que es el mismo que se robo un dinero de un banco y se fue para España, causalidad que Theo tenía sus pocos ahorros guardados en ese banco. La Nena por su parte le reprocha a Aristigueta su mala fe, sabe que lo tenía todo bien planeado para humillar al pobre Theo, el en ves de darle pena le dice a la Nena que lo que mas le sorprende es que ella con ese abolengo que tiene se haya casado con una persona de tan bajo nivel social. Al fin llega Gerson a su casa, Gladis ahora esta mas tranquila. En la casa de Egleé todos se enteran de lo que le paso a la Nena, Rosa que es su amiga se conduele de ella, todo le pasa en el peor de los momentos igual que cuando se caso con Theo, que todo se descubrió en la iglesia, luego se despiden todos y Rómulo se acuesta en el mueble como si el aún viviera allí, Egleé le recuerda que se tiene que ir. Al día siguiente Gladis regaña a Gerson pues se quedo dormido, en la casa de Egleé Cristina le da las llaves del carro a su hermano, pero cuando este sale a la calle en busca de su carro se lleva la sorpresa del día, su carro no esta, justo lo que el sospechaba, el vigilante malandro del edifico de enfrente o sea Gerson le robo el carro, se va para el edificio y lo dice a toda voz, el vigilante de ese edificio le robo su carro por que el lo dice y es así.
